Other words

  • cōmis, cōme — friendly, courteous, nice to people

    adjective, third declension · also used · classical · Cic. Fin. 2.80: et bonum virum et cōmem et hūmānum (Lewis & Short); Ter. Hec. 5.3.39: benignō et lepidō et cōmī (Lewis & Short)

    Cōmis in or ergā aliquem, nice to someone.

  • benevolus, benevola, benevolum — well-wishing, kind, friendly

    adjective; towards someone: ergā + accusative · also used · classical · Traupman 155; Traupman 336

  • facilis, facile — good-natured, easy-going, affable

    also used · classical · Ter. Hec. 5.1.35: facilis benevolusque (Lewis & Short); Cic. Balb. 36: cōmēs, benignī, facilēs, suāvēs hominēs (Lewis & Short); Traupman 323

See also gentle, polite, patient.
